comment: * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: servedDate
variables.comment: The server's time when the cached response was served, if known.

variables.name: lastModified
variables.comment: The last modified date of the cached response, if known.

variables.name: expires
variables.comment:
* The expiration date of the cached response, if known. If both this field
     * and the max age are set, the max age is preferred.

variables.name: sentRequestMillis
variables.comment:
* Extension header set by OkHttp specifying the timestamp when the cached
     * HTTP request was first initiated.

variables.name: receivedResponseMillis
variables.comment:
* Extension header set by OkHttp specifying the timestamp when the cached
     * HTTP response was first received.

methods.name: public CacheStrategy get()
methods.comment:
* Returns a strategy to satisfy {@code request} using the a cached response
     * {@code response}.

methods.name: private CacheStrategy getCandidate()
methods.comment: Returns a strategy to use assuming the request can use the network.

methods.name: private long computeFreshnessLifetime()
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of milliseconds that the response was fresh for,
     * starting from the served date.

methods.name: private long cacheResponseAge()
methods.comment:
* Returns the current age of the response, in milliseconds. The calculation
     * is specified by RFC 2616, 13.2.3 Age Calculations.

methods.name: private boolean isFreshnessLifetimeHeuristic()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if computeFreshnessLifetime used a heuristic. If we used a
     * heuristic to serve a cached response older than 24 hours, we are required
     * to attach a warning.

methods.name: private static boolean hasConditions(Request request)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if the request contains conditions that save the server from
     * sending a response that the client has locally. When a request is enqueued
     * with its own conditions, the built-in response cache won't be used.
